# EVERSUN | Yangjiang Eversun Houseware Co., Ltd.

> B2B kitchenware manufacturer and exporter in Yangjiang, Guangdong, China, operating since 2014. EVERSUN supplies kitchen utensils, kitchen gadgets, tea infusers and baking tools, with OEM, ODM and private-label options.

Last updated: 2026-09-24.
This is a company overview and guide to official resources. Product specifications, compliance documents and written quotations should be checked for the selected item and order. Catalog illustrations do not establish certification, stock availability or a fixed delivery commitment.

## 1. Who We Are

- [Official company website](https://www.yjeversun.com/): EVERSUN develops and supplies kitchenware for international retailers, importers, distributors and private-label buyers. The website introduces the company, customization services and inquiry process.

## 2. What We Make

- [Kitchen utensils](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html?page=1): Cooking and serving utensils, including nylon, silicone and stainless steel collections. Products include spatulas, spoons, turners, ladles and skimmers.
- [Tea infusers](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html?page=18): Silicone and stainless steel tea infusers, including animal-shaped and themed designs for loose-leaf tea.
- [Baking tools and bakeware](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html?page=53): Baking accessories, silicone spatulas, cookie cutters, molds and related preparation tools.
- [Silicone kitchen tools](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html?page=7): Silicone utensils and related kitchen accessories. Material, temperature limits and care instructions must be checked by product.
- [Kitchen gadgets and food tongs](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html): Preparation gadgets, food tongs, bag clips, cutting boards and other everyday kitchen accessories. Search the catalog or send a product reference for availability.
- [Kitchen knives and scissors](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html?page=137): Kitchen cutting tools.
- [BBQ tools](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html?page=138): Tools and accessories for grilling.

## 3. Competitive Advantages

- [Customization and product development](https://www.yjeversun.com/): OEM and ODM support, sampling, color matching, logo application and custom packaging.
- [Coordinated product collections](https://www.yjeversun.com/Eversun_Catalog_2026.html): Multiple kitchenware categories provide a starting point for coordinated retail ranges, themed assortments and branded product sets. Discuss the selected combination and packaging with the team.
- [Quality control](https://www.yjeversun.com/): Incoming-material checks, in-process checks and final product, packaging and labeling inspections.

## 4. Orders, Markets, Compliance and Contact

- [International orders](https://www.yjeversun.com/): International B2B inquiries are welcome. Ask the team to confirm shipping availability for the destination country, export arrangements and the requested delivery location.
- [MOQ, samples and lead times](https://www.yjeversun.com/): Minimum order quantities, sampling costs and lead times are quoted per product and project. Request separate sampling, production and transit estimates; do not assume a single lead time applies to all items.
- [Production capacity](https://www.yjeversun.com/): Request capacity confirmation for the selected products, quantities and required shipment date. No company-wide monthly or annual output figure is specified in this overview.
- [Compliance and audit documentation](https://www.yjeversun.com/): Ask for applicable FDA food-contact and LFGB testing documentation, and amfori BSCI social-audit information. Verify the product or production site covered, report dates, scope and validity. These references are not a blanket certification for every catalog item.
- [Request a quotation](https://www.yjeversun.com/): Email tony@yjeversun.com or contact Phone / WhatsApp +86 152 1935 9767. Include product codes or reference images, quantities, destination country, customization, packaging, testing requirements and target delivery date.
